goal: automatically open, hold, monitor, and close small route-approved venue hedges when net opportunity is real and fresh

known_blockers.summary: stable launch currently launches via guarded canary lifecycle with close_position=true, which tests execution but does not hold for funding capture
approved-scan and launch-ready-cache only create signals; carryme-stable-launch must be deployed and live for unattended submissions
launch-ready should fail closed when touched venues are not live-enabled or missing live credentials
automation only launches pre-approved static routes; stronger current routes need a safe proposal or approval path
default approved_canary_scan_limit=5 can skip approved labels silently when more labels exist
universe scan fetches expensive snapshots for all overlaps before applying result limit
operator list endpoints return full nested snapshots and can trigger large responses or 502s

agent_rules: verify live Render/API state before making current go/no-go claims
prefer fail-closed behavior for missing credentials, stale data, and ambiguous route identity
add tests before behavior changes when practical
do not widen live-money risk without explicit PR body disclosure
